name: search-term-in-all-docs
$comment: search terminal over a declared search index, seedable without a model only when the term matches every doc: the client engines over-approximate search-text matching to the whole table, so a term present in ALL bodies makes the four implementations agree on the candidate set. The server ranks by ts_rank; result order is not portable, hence unordered. Derived from the golden-vector search case (search_task_filter_todo) minus the filter.
